raidBosses.notes: Moves and ultimate are IDs from learnsets.json. Boss level follows the highest level or average in the participating team. The base HP multiplier gains a configurable percentage for each distinct participating viewer (default 3%). Boss ultimates recharge normally and have a 14-second reuse delay. Each moveset can contain up to seven regular moves.
